documents.text: A customer can request a refund within thirty days of purchase. The payment is returned to the original card after the returned product arrives.
A customer can exchange a purchased shirt for another size within thirty days. Exchanges replace the item and do not return money.
To reset a forgotten password, choose Forgot password on the sign in page. A reset link is sent to the account email address.
To change the email address on an account, open profile settings while signed in and confirm the new address using a verification message.
The nightly backup copies database records to an encrypted archive. A restore operation recovers records deleted accidentally.
The export tool downloads current database records as a CSV file for spreadsheet analysis. An export is not a scheduled backup.
The airport train leaves the central station every twenty minutes. Train tickets can be bought at station machines before boarding.
The airport bus leaves the central station every forty minutes. Bus tickets are sold by the driver after passengers board.
The indoor fern needs moist soil and indirect sunlight. Water the plant when the top layer of soil begins to dry.
The desert cactus prefers direct sunlight and dry soil. Let the soil dry completely between occasional waterings.
Canceling a subscription stops the next automatic renewal. Existing paid access continues until the end of the billing period.
Pausing a subscription suspends access temporarily and resumes billing automatically on the selected restart date.
